decisions.reason: The startup accelerator sits outside the core machinery business and has no reported results to meet an aspiration level, so problemistic search is likely to redirect its resources to core recycling technology.

Although it is far from the core and has no performance evidence, the bio-based bitumen binder is positioned as a flagship with its own page, and the growing firm has enough slack to carry this uncertain product for another year.
The infectious waste plant is a flagship launched with the partner ERMAFA and close to the firm's core, so the growing firm's slack lets it keep the product while results develop.
The mobile mechanical recycling plant extends the core WASTX modular line directly and fits the decentralized strategy, so there is little reason to search for alternatives.
